title: From Fixed Defaults to Calibrated Activation Policies for Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.06559v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term time-series forecasting supports decisions in energy, transportation, and other applications where reliable predictions are needed beyond the observed data. Although forecasting research has advanced model architectures, fixed activation configurations provide limited guidance on how activation choices should vary across datasets and prediction horizons. This study aims to establish when task-specific activation choices improve forecasting accuracy and how previous experiments can guide the selection of suitable configurations for new tasks. We develop a calibrated selection policy that learns a reliable default from prior experiments, adapts the activation function and its location to each task, and retains the default when evidence for a change is insufficient. translated_title: 从固定默认配置到经过校准的激活策略：面向长期时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 长期时间序列预测为能源、交通等应用的决策提供支持，这些应用需要在观测数据范围之外获得可靠的预测结果。尽管预测研究在模型架构方面取得了进展，但固定的激活配置对于激活选择应如何随数据集和预测时域变化所提供的指导十分有限。本研究旨在确定任务特定的激活选择何时能够提升预测精度，以及如何利用先前的实验结果来指导为新任务选择合适的配置。我们开发了一种经过校准的选择策略，该策略从先前实验中学习一个可靠的默认配置，针对每个任务自适应地调整激活函数及其位置，并在证据不足时保留默认配置。在一项由1,225次Informer训练运行支持的评估中，涵盖17个数据集变体和51个预测任务，该策略平均将均方误差降低了7.86%。
tldr: 该研究提出一种经过校准的激活选择策略，能够根据任务自适应地选择激活函数及其位置，并在证据不足时保留默认配置，在1,225次Informer训练实验中平均将长期时间序列预测的均方误差降低7.86%。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a calibrated activation selection policy that adaptively chooses the activation function and its placement per task while retaining a reliable default when evidence is insufficient, reducing MSE by 7.86% on average across 1,225 Informer training runs for long-term time-series forecasting.
